name: desk
description: A place to write: the draft notes in full, with pinned notes kept to one side.

use.when: the person is writing something longer than a line, as notes, and wants the drafts in view with the notes they keep coming back to beside them.
use.not: a short note on its own, which is a note record, or a to-do list, which is the week arrangement.
use.with: the writing as note records, made with create_record from the person's own words; a draft is status draft, and pinning a note puts it to one side.
